tuning_policy: Held-out set. Nobody tunes prompts, tools, thresholds, labels or routing against individual items. The only permitted use is one release run and its aggregate scorer report, including per-question check output for audit. Do not select examples, prompts or fixes from this set.
phase_policy: Season-level questions use the regular season. A question naming playoffs, overall or all phases uses that phase. A question naming an opponent spans every phase unless it also names a phase. A date window uses the named dates; a relative window spans every phase. A specific game is that game. Player averages count only appearances with minutes > 0. Follow-up turns inherit the game established in their session context. Team nicknames are canonicalised before the shared policy runs, without changing the policy rules.
notes: No model labels. Every fact is computed from the active local release.
No live provider call was made while building or checking this set.
Questions, players, opponents and game ids are disjoint from questions.jsonl and heldout_questions.jsonl; the overlap report is mechanical and contains no question text.
creation_commit is the first commit that added the set; set_commit is the commit whose questions.jsonl and follow_ups.jsonl bytes match this file.
Run once at release. Do not tune on it.
